description_en: Queries the LAN configurations of a Smart Access Gateway device
description_zh: 调用DescribeSagLanList查询智能接入网关设备LAN配置
name: DescribeSagLanList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the associated Smart Access Gateway device
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备的序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

Lans.description_en: The list of LAN port information

EndIp.description_en: The end address of the DHCP address pool

IP.description_en: The IP address of the LAN port

IPType.description_en:
The connection type of the LAN port. Valid values:

DHCP: Dynamic IP. Uses the DHCP protocol to dynamically assign IP addresses to connected devices.

STATIC: Static IP. Statically specifies the IP address of the LAN port
IPType.description_zh:
LAN口连接类型。

DHCP：动态IP。利用DHCP协议，向连接设备动态下发IP地址。

STATIC：静态IP。静态指定LAN口IP地址

Lease.description_en: The DHCP lease time. Unit: minutes

StartIp.description_en: The start IP address of the DHCP address pool

TaskStates.description_en: The status information of the query task

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the query task was created

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. 200 indicates that the query task succeeded
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。200标识查询任务成功

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. Successful indicates that the query task succeeded
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误信息。Successful标识查询任务成功

State.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous task. Valid values:
Initialized: The query task is initialized.
Offline: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task is not delivered. The task will be delivered after the device comes online.
Succeed: The query task was delivered successfully.
Processing: The query task is being delivered.
VersionNotSupport: The current version of the Smart Access Gateway device does not support this operation.
BuildRequestError: The request is not supported by the management system.
HardwareError: The query task failed to be delivered due to a device error.
TaskNotExist: The query task does not exist.
OfflineNotConfiged: The Smart Access Gateway device is offline and the query task is not delivered. The task will not be delivered even after the device comes online
State.description_zh:
异步任务状态：
Initialized：查询任务初始化。
Offline：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后会继续下发。
Succeed：查询任务下发成功。
Processing：查询任务下发中。
VersionNotSupport：智能接入网关设备当前版本不支持。
BuildRequestError：管控不支持。
HardwareError：由于设备原因查询任务下发失败。
TaskNotExist：查询任务不存在。
OfflineNotConfiged：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后也不会下发
